text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Being selfish just causes trouble for<n>everyone
else.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I had to prove that the sacrifices they<n>made in
sending me off were worth it.<n>I couldn't afford to
waste a single<n>second.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Because I love my family.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was afraid my sisters would think I<n>was getting
special treatment. I didn't<n>want to see the family I
worked so<n>hard to support fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I convinced myself I had to becomethis reliable older sister. I had toprotect our cozy home in any way Icould.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But the truth is I'm not the big hero I<n>thought I
could be. I'm still just plain<n>old me...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And my family loves me just the<n>way I am...
They're happy to bless<n>me with all their support.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I... am Ines Fujin, and right now, I can<n>just keep on
enjoying racing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... These cheers are soloud!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This feels incredible!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (If running with 100% of my strength<n>is what I do...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I want to spread my arms wide and<n>welcome
everyone's feelings with<n>100% of my energy too.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer! And I want to<n>discuss our next
goal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I was thinking we could do the<n>Takarazuka Kinen!

The Takarazuka Kinen is a<n>2,200-meter G1 held in
June. It's a<n>grand prix, meaning the most popular
runners get to take the turf.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You need a lot of fans to run in a<n>grand prix, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that got me thinking—maybe<n>running in the
Takarazuka Kinen<n>means you're, like, carrying the
weight of people's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I know that compared to others, there<n>might not be
as many people who<n>see their dreams in me, but
still...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand on that great big stage<n>and live up to
those dreams anyway.<n>I want to show that I can
bear that<n>burden.

Caught up in her sheer determination,<n>I find myself
imagining who else<n>might be running in this year's
Takarazuka Kinen.
choice_data_list:
That means you'll have to beat Mejiro Ryan and
Mejiro McQueen.

That means you'll have to beat Mejiro Ryan and
Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ryan and McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
How do you know they'll be there?<n>The spring G1
races have only just<n>started, right?
choice_data_list:
Because I know everyone's expecting great things
from them both.

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen<n>have both been
the subject of an<n>enormous amount of attention
lately.

I'm not sure if "perfect" is the word,<n>but the way
McQueen stalks the pace<n>before overpowering the
competition<n>is really something.

And then there's Ryan, who's gained<n>popularity by
displaying a level of<n>determination worthy of her
family<n>name, remaining resilient no matter<n>what.

They've both become pillars of the<n>current racing
scene.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So they're going to be entering for<n>sure. If this is
going to be the race of<n>people's dreams, those two
have got<n>to be there.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha... Now I get it! I really am<n>hopeless, aren't I?!
choice_data_list: People are expecting great things from you too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh—I mean, thanks for the vote<n>of confidence,
but... I wasn't really<n>talking about my chances in
the race.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's just that... I've been so focused<n>on myself
recently, I feel like I've<n>been living under a rock.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's like the only thing I've been<n>thinking about is
me, you know? I<n>really think I should broaden my
perspective.
choice_data_list:
But there's nothing wrong with being totally
focused on one thing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You always have to back me uplike that, don't you?

It's my job as her trainer to support<n>her, after all.
And besides...
choice_data_list:
I want you to be totally absorbed in running, that's
all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But I'm pretty sure I'm already<n>too absorbed
in it...

Watching Ines Fujin scratch her<n>cheek sheepishly,
I'm reminded of<n>the conversations I've had with
others about her.
We all feel exactly the same way.
choice_data_list:
(We all want her to enjoy racing to the absolute
fullest.)

text_block_list.text:
That's why, as her trainer, I'll<n>continue to do my
best to support her!<n>And now it's time to focus on
our<n>next goal—the Takarazuka Kinen!
